affected_region_B.instructions: Examine only the upper-row MRI panel labelled B in `document_image`. Which anatomical region contains the areas indicated by the white arrows? Select Unable to determine if localization is uncertain. Do not diagnose cerebral palsy or infer clinical severity.

criteria.Periventricular white matter: White matter surrounding the lateral ventricles.
criteria.Cerebral cortex: The outer cortical layer of the cerebral hemispheres.
criteria.Unable to determine: The anatomical region cannot be identified reliably.

marked_region_B.instructions: In the upper-row panel labelled B in `document_image`, locate the tissue region immediately around the tip of the white arrow on the image-left side. Return a tight rectangle around that single region, excluding the other panels and the arrow shaft.

hie_related_pattern.instructions: For educational review, assess only upper-row panel B in `document_image`. Are the visible findings suggestive of chronic hypoxic-ischaemic injury? Consider alternative explanations and image limitations. Do not establish the cause or timing of injury from this image alone. Annotations are not proof of a diagnosis.

criteria.Potentially suggestive: Visible findings may be compatible with chronic hypoxic-ischaemic injury, but require specialist confirmation.
criteria.No clear supporting features: No clear supporting features are visible in this panel; this does not exclude previous injury.
criteria.Indeterminate: The findings are nonspecific or the image and clinical information are insufficient.

hie_sequelae_location.instructions: For educational review, examine upper-row panel B in `document_image`. Locate the single most clearly visible region that may represent chronic hypoxic-ischaemic injury sequelae. Return a tight rectangle around that region, excluding other panels, labels and annotation arrows. Do not assume the cause of an abnormality is HIE solely because it is highlighted.

cerebral_palsy_status.instructions: What do the supplied clinical notes establish about cerebral palsy? Do not diagnose from the MRI alone.

criteria.Confirmed diagnosis: Clinical notes explicitly document a clinician-confirmed CP diagnosis.
criteria.Suspected or under assessment: Clinical notes explicitly describe suspected CP or ongoing assessment.
criteria.Explicitly ruled out: Clinical notes explicitly state that CP was ruled out.
criteria.Insufficient information: No clear clinical conclusion is supplied, records conflict, or only imaging is provided.

adhd_status.instructions: What do the supplied clinical notes establish about ADHD? Do not infer ADHD from MRI appearance or a CP diagnosis.

criteria.Confirmed diagnosis: Clinical notes explicitly document a specialist-confirmed ADHD diagnosis.

criteria.Explicitly ruled out: Clinical notes explicitly state that ADHD was ruled out.
criteria.Insufficient information: No clear clinical conclusion is supplied, records conflict, or only imaging is provided.
